news.headline: Why Adam Schefter is concerned about Malik Nabers' Week 1 availability
news.description: Adam Schefter tells Pat McAfee that he doesn't like what he's hearing surrounding Malik Nabers as he works back from a knee injury.

news.headline: Packers' Jacobs arrested, faces several domestic violence charges
news.description: Packers running back Josh Jacobs was arrested Tuesday and booked on several domestic violence charges, according to the Hobart-Lawrence (Wisconsin) Police Department.

news.headline: Source: Bucs RB Bucky Irving (shoulder) likely ready by summer
news.description: Buccaneers running back Bucky Irving, who is rehabbing from offseason shoulder surgery, should be ready later this summer, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

news.headline: Harbaugh: Nabers' knee injury 'not simple,' clouding return date
news.description: The Giants don't know when star wide receiver Malik Nabers will be back from what coach John Harbaugh said Thursday was "not a simple knee" injury.

news.headline: Patrick Mahomes back on field for Chiefs' first OTA practice
news.description: Chiefs QB Patrick Mahomes returned to the field with his teammates Tuesday for the first time since tearing the ACL and LCL in his left knee.

news.headline: Panthers QB Bryce Young becoming more vocal leader in Year 4
news.description: Panthers quarterback Bryce Young has slowly been developing into a more vocal leader as he enters Year 4 of his tenure with the Panthers.

news.headline: Texans give star WR Nico Collins raise in reworked deal
news.description: Two-time Pro Bowl wide receiver Nico Collins and the Texans reached agreement on an adjusted contract that guarantees his salary the next two seasons and includes a $9 million cash increase this year and an $8 million cash increase next year.

news.headline: Raiders to put 'a lot' of pressure on Ashton Jeanty in Year 2
news.description: If Klint Kubiak's offense is going to function properly, it will need more out of the star running back.

news.headline: Titans say OSU's Carnell Tate was perfect fit for Cam Ward
news.description: With premium defensive options on the board, Tennessee made unanimous decision to get an impact player on offense.

news.headline: Will Pats QB Drake Maye improve in second year with McDaniels?
news.description: The New England quarterback is entering a vital second season with his offensive coordinator.

news.headline: Jordan Love, Ronika Stone welcome first child together
news.description: Jordan Love and Ronika Stone have spent a full month with their newborn daughter.

news.headline: Jacoby Brissett not close to reworked deal with Cardinals
news.description: A reworked deal between the Arizona Cardinals and quarterback Jacoby Brissett is still not close, a source told ESPN on Friday.

news.headline: Sources: Rams' Matthew Stafford lands 1-year, $55M extension
news.description: Reigning NFL MVP Matthew Stafford and the Rams reached agreement on a one-year, $55 million extension, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter. The QB is now tied to L.A. through the 2027 season, with $105 million remaining on his deal.

news.headline: Chris Canty: Rams wanted to make sure Stafford was happy after Simpson pick
news.description: Chris Canty believes the Rams gave Matthew Stafford his one-year, $55 million extension to keep him happy after selecting Ty Simpson in the first round.

news.headline: Cards' Michael Wilson ready to build off big 2025 season
news.description: Michael Wilson is eligible for an extension, and his production in the second half of last season could set him up for a nice payday.

news.headline: Trevor Lawrence's family, friends voiced concern over faux haircut
news.description: The Jaguars quarterback's trademark flowing blonde hair disappeared during the team's schedule reveal video.
